🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-11-08 23:00 → 2026-11-09 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **PR-head check passed** — an independent review confirmed that the allowlist plus safe-argument handling closes the direct shell path. [PR #88 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/88#pullrequestreview-5820238132)

> **Runner surface narrowed** — the recompute_repo fix now limits execution to allowlisted test runners and pins mcp<2. [PR #88](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/88)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### recompute-kit MCP hardening
_The hardening loop moved from closing a direct path to checking the whole containment boundary._

- Baby Blue Viper **Reviewed** PR #88 and confirmed the direct shell path was closed, while naming three remaining incident-class gaps, including runners still running code from the caller's repository and allowed arguments that name a program. [tg:tawg:6276]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Agreed** with all three findings and backed containment over more parsing, keeping the fix aimed at isolating execution rather than chasing every argument form. [comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/88#issuecomment-6729220932)
- Baby Blue Viper **Re-checked** commit 42423e6 and found both the shell path and the clone side closed. [re-check](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/88#issuecomment-6732781083)
- Merlini (@gobross) **Confirmed** that glued short forms such as -pevil had slipped past the first pass and carried them into the follow-up fix. [follow-up](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/88#issuecomment-6738905758)

### ERC-8004 reputation
_The reputation thread moved from implementation reporting toward reproducible evidence._

- parthdagia05 **Shared** an implementation report on payment-bound, human-unique feedback for the ERC-8004 Reputation Registry, giving the spec discussion a concrete implementation reference. [forum post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/438)
- sickgolf **Asked** to see the MFRM output behind that report and flagged the forum's image-only upload limit as the obstacle to sharing it. [forum reply](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/439)

### zkIE proving stack
_A broad proving-stack refactor arrived for review._

- Jimmy Shi **Opened** a refactor covering soundness hardening and a performance overhaul, giving reviewers one place to assess both together. [zkIE PR #47](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/47)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- Turn the remaining incident-class gaps into explicit regression tests around the containment boundary.
- Reproduce the MFRM output behind the reputation write-up so the comparison is easy to share.
- Read the proving-stack refactor as a soundness question first, then revisit performance.

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Re-check the recompute-kit PR head after the glued short-form patch for further argument shapes.
- Line up a reviewer for the zkIE refactor's soundness claims.
- Ask for the details behind the reputation report so others can reproduce it.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A fix moved fastest when review and author kept passing the same baton — gaps named, framing agreed, bypasses closed.
>
> May every review today land with that same satisfying click, like a well-sealed container. 🧰
